title: Out-of-Memory Issue with TeaCache Acceleration on RTX 4090 (24GB) for Wan2.1 Workflow
body:
Update: I switched to the wan2.1_i2v_720p_14b_fp16 model, and in this case, the out-of-memory issue no longer occurs

I am encountering an out-of-memory issue when using TeaCache to accelerate the official Wan2.1 workflow in ComfyUI. Below are the details of my setup and the problem:

Environment:
GPU: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM)
RAM: 64GB
Model: wan2.1_i2v_720p_14b_bf16
Output Video: 81 frames at a resolution of 848x480
Problem Description:
When I enable TeaCache acceleration with the following settings:

Skip Steps: 3
Acceleration Weight: 0.2
The GPU memory usage exceeds the available 24GB VRAM, spilling over into shared memory by approximately 0.5–0.7GB. This results in performance degradation due to the reliance on slower shared memory.

However, when I disable TeaCache acceleration, the GPU memory usage fits perfectly within the 24GB limit, and the process runs smoothly without any issues.

Additionally, the memory overflow behavior is inconsistent:

Some steps during the process cause memory to overflow into shared memory.
After a short period, the memory is released, and the overflow disappears.
This fluctuation suggests that memory management during TeaCache acceleration may not be optimal.
Expected Behavior:
TeaCache should ideally optimize memory usage while accelerating the workflow, ensuring that the total GPU memory consumption remains within the available 24GB VRAM. Memory fluctuations and overflow into shared memory should be minimized or avoided entirely.

Additional Notes:
The issue occurs consistently across multiple runs.
I am using the latest version of TeaCache and ComfyUI, as well as the official Wan2.1 workflow configuration.
My system has sufficient RAM (64GB), so memory swapping to system RAM should not be necessary.
Could you please investigate this issue and provide guidance on how to resolve it? Let me know if additional logs or debugging information is required from my side.

Thank you!
author: shuaixn

comments.body: Thank you for your valuable feedback, I will take the time to look into this issue.
@shuaixn hi, just now I optimize `TeaCache` node for the VRAM usage. The issue about memory fluctuations has been alleviated. You can enjoy this change in version `1.4.1`.

title: refactor: Remove steps from the node settings，fix RuntimeError “The size of tensor a must match the size of tensor b”
body:
- Remove the steps configuration item in the node.
- Remove unnecessary counter variables (cnt).
- Optimize the calculation and reset logic of cumulative relative L1 distance.
- Fix the problem of “RuntimeError: The size of tensor a must match the size of tensor b” when there are multiple samplers with different numbers of steps in the workflow.  
 
The following issues were fixed in this commit:  #4 #7 #8 #15 #17 

Now, you only need to add a teacache node at the start of the workflow to work with multiple samplers
author: TangYanxin

comments.body:
“RuntimeError: The size of tensor a must match the size of tensor b” 问题的原因是
1. 你把步数和当前步数计数器设置为类属性，ComfyUI会缓存节点导致执行一次后记录的值是最后一个TeaCache节点的，
2. 如果工作流中有多个步数不一样的采样器，当前步数计数器的值就可能出错，会错误执行accumulated_rel_l1_distance计算逻辑
3. 你在accumulated_rel_l1_distance计算逻辑部分没做异常处理，所以看到这个错误
Thank you for your contribution! Your solution is really elegant and increases the usability of the TeaCache node. Thank you very much!

title: Workflow with Split Samplers: RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (15808) must match the size of tensor b (3952) at non-singleton dimension 1
body:
Thank you for your efforts to make this work in Comfy. It's greatly appreciated!

I have a workflow that is split into two separate Samplers. The first Sampler runs for 20-steps. I then perform a 2x upscale on the image. After that, I run the upscaled image through a second Sampler for 8-steps at a low denoise to get a nice sharply detailed image.

When adding this TeaCache node to my workflow, the first Sampler runs successfully... and fast! However, following the upscale, the second Sampler errors with the text in the title. I can make the workflow complete "successfully" by adding a second TeaCache node just before the second Sampler to disable the TeaCache, but then the second Sampler runs slowly. Do you know of any way to make the TeaCache nodes work on BOTH my Samplers?

Thank you for your time!
